summary: Remote WebSocket-controlled shell and host-management surface
details: The @yeaft/webchat-agent package runs a long-lived agent that connects outbound to a configured WebSocket server, authenticates with a shared secret, and then dispatches inbound server messages to handlers that (a) spawn a PTY (bash / powershell / cmd) and write raw server-supplied bytes into it via term.pty.write(msg.data) in terminal.js, and (b) expose read_file, write_file, create_file, delete_files, move_files, copy_files, upload_to_dir, transfer_files, git_add/reset/restore/commit/push, arbitrary local HTTP/WS proxying, MCP config mutation, and an upgrade_agent handler that runs `npm install <pkg>@latest` and restarts. All of these are reached from switch(msg.type) in message-router.js on frames received from socket.on('message'). Any party operating the WebSocket endpoint and holding the shared secret obtains interactive shell, arbitrary filesystem read/write, git push under the user's credentials, local-port pivoting, and self-update-driven code execution on the host running the agent, under the account that started it.
